text:
aria: Quick q — when deploy-bot auto-bumps a patch for infra-only changes, do we keep the semver strictly MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH or can we append buildmeta like 1.2.3+ci.456? thinking about deploy tracing and rollback matching.
sam: Prefer strict semver for tags. buildmeta is fine for CI artifacts but release tags used by deploybot should be canonical.
kevin: +1. Also: our rollback tooling matches tags exactly, so adding +buildmeta could break rollback lookups in older tooling.
julia: What about a short suffix instead, like 1.2.3-ci456 or 1.2.3-build456? we've used hyphen pre-release for rc earlier.
aria: Good point. Examples:
```
# canonical tag
v1.2.3
# CI artifact
v1.2.3+ci.456
# hyphen suffix option
v1.2.3-ci456
```
releasebot: deploy-bot policy: will only publish tags matching `^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$` to prod by default. Non-matching tags are considered ephemeral. See /releasebot help for config.
kevin: If releasebot ignores non-canonical tags, then we should keep prod tags clean (v1.2.3). CI can push buildmeta to artifact registry only.
sam: How does this interact with backports? If we cherry-pick and bump a patch in a branch, we want the tag to be obvious and parsable in changelogs.
julia: Suggestion: deploy-bot publishes v1.2.3 for prod (pushes annotated tag). CI writes +buildmeta into the image/manifest only. Any test deploys get a -ci suffix for easier filtering.
aria: Can deploy-bot update release notes to include the CI run id? that would preserve single canonical tag and still capture trace.
deploy-bot: yes — we can add `ci_run: 456` in the release body. Automated note available when `--include-ci` is set.
sam: Another edge: what about library consumers that depend on semantic tags (e.g., npm). If we start producing v1.2.3-ci... it might confuse package managers.
kevin: Exactly — for package registries we must avoid non-semver tags unless they are pre-release (hyphen). But pre-release implies not stable.
julia: So final proposal: production tags are strict vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. CI uses buildmeta (not tags) or hyphen suffixes only on ephemeral artifacts. deploy-bot will not consider non-canonical tags for rollouts.
aria: OK. can someone update the releasebot docs and deploy-bot config? I'll create a PR referencing this thread.
sam: thanks, please add a short note in rollback runbook about tag matching.
kevin: ack.
releasebot: noted. Created checklist item: "ensure tag matches ^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$ for prod" :white_check_mark:
aria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
